input.title: Command Center bounces back when user does a slow swipe down and let go
input.body:
## Step to reproduce
1. Create a thought
2. Swipe up to open Command Center
3. Slow swipe down and let go the Command Center bar


## Current behavior
Command Center bar bounces back
**Video:**

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/77cbd9a1-9cfe-4c0a-b146-0bc26e8e9449

## Expected behavior
Command Center should close
